# A vector zero inside a feature-guarded loop must not be hoisted to
# function entry. Check the emitted control flow even on hosts whose
# CPU supports every tested instruction, then exercise both dispatches.
[!GOARCH:amd64] skip 'SIMD dominance objdump needs amd64'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOEXPERIMENT=simd
env GOAMD64=v1
env GODEBUG=

cd g
go build -o $WORK/checkguard ./checkguard
go build -gcflags=-d=ssa/check/on -o $WORK/go-exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.nested256$' $WORK/go-exe
cp stdout $WORK/go-256.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/go-256.txt AVX2
stdout '^guard dominates SIMD$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.nested512$' $WORK/go-exe
cp stdout $WORK/go-512.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/go-512.txt AVX512
stdout '^guard dominates SIMD$'
exec $WORK/go-exe
stdout '^sums ok$'

env GODEBUG=cpu.avx2=off,cpu.avx512f=off
exec $WORK/go-exe
stdout '^features false false$'
stdout '^sums ok$'

cd ../l
env GODEBUG=
logos build -O=2 -gcflags=-d=ssa/check/on -o $WORK/logos-exe .
go tool objdump -s '^main\.nested256$' $WORK/logos-exe
cp stdout $WORK/logos-256.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/logos-256.txt AVX2
stdout '^guard dominates SIMD$'
go tool objdump -s '^main\.nested512$' $WORK/logos-exe
cp stdout $WORK/logos-512.txt
exec $WORK/checkguard $WORK/logos-512.txt AVX512
stdout '^guard dominates SIMD$'
exec $WORK/logos-exe
stdout '^sums ok$'
env GODEBUG=cpu.avx2=off,cpu.avx512f=off
exec $WORK/logos-exe
stdout '^features false false$'
stdout '^sums ok$'

-- g/go.mod --
module example.com/simdzerogo

go 1.27

-- g/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"simd/archsimd"
)

//go:noinline
func nested256(xs []int32, repeats int) int32 {
	var total int32
	for range repeats {
		if archsimd.X86.AVX2() {
			var acc archsimd.Int32x8
			i := 0
			for len(xs)-i >= 8 {
				acc = acc.Add(archsimd.LoadInt32x8(xs[i:]))
				i += 8
			}
			var lanes [8]int32
			acc.StoreArray(&lanes)
			for _, v := range lanes {
				total += v
			}
			for ; i < len(xs); i++ {
				total += xs[i]
			}
		} else {
			for _, v := range xs {
				total += v
			}
		}
	}
	return total
}

//go:noinline
func nested512(xs []uint8, repeats int) uint8 {
	var total uint8
	for range repeats {
		if archsimd.X86.AVX512() {
			var acc archsimd.Uint8x64
			i := 0
			for len(xs)-i >= 64 {
				acc = acc.Add(archsimd.LoadUint8x64(xs[i:]))
				i += 64
			}
			var lanes [64]uint8
			acc.StoreArray(&lanes)
			for _, v := range lanes {
				total += v
			}
			for ; i < len(xs); i++ {
				total += xs[i]
			}
		} else {
			for _, v := range xs {
				total += v
			}
		}
	}
	return total
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("features", archsimd.X86.AVX2(), archsimd.X86.AVX512())
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 7, 8, 9, 63, 64, 65, 129} {
		xs := make([]int32, n)
		us := make([]uint8, n)
		var want32 int32
		var want8 uint8
		for i := range n {
			xs[i] = int32(i*17 - 91)
			us[i] = uint8(i*13 + 1)
			want32 += xs[i]
			want8 += us[i]
		}
		for _, repeats := range []int{0, 1, 3} {
			if got := nested256(xs, repeats); got != want32*int32(repeats) {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("int32 n=%d repeats=%d: got %d", n, repeats, got))
			}
			if got := nested512(us, repeats); got != want8*uint8(repeats) {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("uint8 n=%d repeats=%d: got %d", n, repeats, got))
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}

-- l/go.mod --
module example.com/simdzerologos

go 1.27

-- l/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"simd/archsimd"
)

//go:noinline
func nested256(xs []int32, repeats int) int32 {
	var total int32
	for range repeats {
		total += xs.sum()
	}
	return total
}

//go:noinline
func nested512(xs []uint8, repeats int) uint8 {
	var total uint8
	for range repeats {
		total += xs.sum()
	}
	return total
}

func main() {
	fmt.Println("features", archsimd.X86.AVX2(), archsimd.X86.AVX512())
	for _, n := range []int{0, 1, 7, 8, 9, 63, 64, 65, 129} {
		xs := make([]int32, n)
		us := make([]uint8, n)
		var want32 int32
		var want8 uint8
		for i := range n {
			xs[i] = int32(i*17 - 91)
			us[i] = uint8(i*13 + 1)
			want32 += xs[i]
			want8 += us[i]
		}
		for _, repeats := range []int{0, 1, 3} {
			if got := nested256(xs, repeats); got != want32*int32(repeats) {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("int32 n=%d repeats=%d: got %d", n, repeats, got))
			}
			if got := nested512(us, repeats); got != want8*uint8(repeats) {
				panic(fmt.Sprintf("uint8 n=%d repeats=%d: got %d", n, repeats, got))
			}
		}
	}
	fmt.Println("sums ok")
}

-- g/checkguard/main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

type instruction struct {
	pc   uint64
	op   string
	args string
}

func fail(format string, args ...any) {
	fmt.Fprintf(os.Stderr, format+"\n", args...)
	os.Exit(1)
}

func address(s string) uint64 {
	pc, err := strconv.ParseUint(s, 0, 64)
	if err != nil {
		fail("invalid instruction address %q: %v", s, err)
	}
	return pc
}

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 3 || (os.Args[2] != "AVX2" && os.Args[2] != "AVX512") {
		fail("usage: checkguard <objdump> AVX2|AVX512")
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(os.Args[1])
	if err != nil {
		fail("read objdump: %v", err)
	}
	var code []instruction
	index := make(map[uint64]int)
	symbol := ""
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(data), "\n") {
		fields := strings.Fields(line)
		if len(fields) == 0 {
			continue
		}
		if fields[0] == "TEXT" {
			if len(fields) < 2 || symbol != "" {
				fail("expected exactly one function")
			}
			symbol = fields[1]
			continue
		}
		if len(fields) < 4 || !strings.HasPrefix(fields[1], "0x") {
			fail("invalid objdump instruction %q", line)
		}
		pc := address(fields[1])
		if _, exists := index[pc]; exists {
			fail("duplicate instruction address %#x", pc)
		}
		index[pc] = len(code)
		code = append(code, instruction{pc, fields[3], strings.Join(fields[4:], " ")})
	}
	if len(code) == 0 {
		fail("missing function instructions")
	}
	guard := -1
	for i, ins := range code {
		next := i + 1
		switch {
		case ins.op == "CALL" && ins.args == "simd/archsimd.X86Features."+os.Args[2]+"(SB)":
			if next >= len(code) || code[next].op != "TESTL" || code[next].args != "AL, AL" {
				fail("feature call must be followed by TESTL AL, AL")
			}
			next++
		case ins.op == "CMPB" && strings.HasPrefix(ins.args, "internal/cpu.X86+") && strings.HasSuffix(ins.args, "(SB), $0x0"):
			// The fixture's sole X86 field read is its inlined feature
			// predicate. Its layout offset is not part of this contract.
		default:
			continue
		}
		if guard >= 0 || next >= len(code) || (code[next].op != "JE" && code[next].op != "JNE") {
			fail("expected one feature predicate followed by JE/JNE")
		}
		guard = next
	}
	if guard < 0 {
		fail("missing %s feature branch", os.Args[2])
	}
	// Remove the feature-true edge. No feature-dependent instruction may
	// remain reachable from entry, including across loops or cold paths.
	seen := make([]bool, len(code))
	work := []int{0}
	vectors := 0
	for _, ins := range code {
		if strings.HasPrefix(ins.op, "V") || strings.HasPrefix(ins.op, "K") {
			vectors++
		}
	}
	if vectors == 0 {
		fail("missing vector instructions")
	}
	for len(work) != 0 {
		i := work[len(work)-1]
		work = work[:len(work)-1]
		if i >= len(code) || seen[i] {
			continue
		}
		seen[i] = true
		ins := code[i]
		if strings.HasPrefix(ins.op, "V") || strings.HasPrefix(ins.op, "K") {
			fail("%s at %#x is reachable without %s", ins.op, ins.pc, os.Args[2])
		}
		if ins.op == "RET" || ins.op == "UD2" || ins.op == "INT" || ins.op == "HLT" {
			continue
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(ins.op, "J") {
			pc := code[0].pc
			if ins.args != symbol {
				pc = address(ins.args)
			}
			target, ok := index[pc]
			if !ok {
				fail("jump at %#x leaves function", ins.pc)
			}
			if i != guard || ins.op == "JE" {
				work = append(work, target)
			}
			if ins.op == "JMP" || (i == guard && ins.op == "JE") {
				continue
			}
		}
		work = append(work, i+1)
	}
	fmt.Println("guard dominates SIMD")
}
